translation.from: The AIM service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a little while.

translation.from: The screen name or password you entered is invalid.
translation.to: 输入的账号或密码无效。

translation.from: Unknown password problem. It is possible that your password exceeds the maximum length allowed by AIM/ICQ. Remember that ICQ passwords can be no longer than 8 characters and AIM passwords no longer than 16. Close this connection and re-create it through the connection manager with the proper password length.
translation.to: 未知密码问题：您的密码可能超出AIM/ICQ允许的最大长度。ICQ密码最长8字符，AIM密码最长16字符。请关闭连接并使用正确长度的密码重新创建。

translation.from: You are attempting to sign on again too soon. Please wait ~15 minutes and try again! Do not login during this period or it will only extend itself.
translation.to: 登录过于频繁，请等待约15分钟后再试！期间请勿登录，否则等待时间会延长。

translation.from: You are currently signed onto AIM using another client (most likely WinAIM). Please close this application and retry. This behavior will be fixed in a future release.
translation.to: 您正通过其他客户端（可能是WinAIM）登录AIM。请关闭该应用后重试，此问题将在未来版本修复。
